$comment: Copy Agent Reference (T52 item 4, PEN-69; version 3, PEN-155: no server or notebook named, since one penmoss mcp serves every notebook): each case is the input (id: the note’s ULID; notebookId: its notebook.json id, which gives the note its short id; noteIds: the notebook’s other notes, an older one ending as this one does making the short id the whole ULID) and the exact one line every client copies. Written from core’s agentReference by apps/web/test/unit/agent-reference-contract.test.ts; read by the Android app’s contract test.

cases.name: a git notebook’s note: its short id, which finds its notebook
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: another notebook id gives another 4 characters
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"KFAP-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: the hash covers the whole notebook id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"KVAQ-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: an older note ending the same way: the whole id after the notebook’s 4 characters
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-01M6VAE8YFZ99TCZV2SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: a later note ending the same way changes nothing
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: line breaks and spaces around the id: one line
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"ETD7-SXF7SQ9W"}

cases.name: without a notebook id: the whole id
cases.expected: Reference note via Penmoss MCP tool read_note {"id":"01JBXYZ0000000000000000000"}
